ideas.pitch: An automated market research engine tailored for Startup Street's ideation phase, combining web scraping and LLMs to instantly calculate Total Addressable Market (TAM) and competitor density from live data.
ideas.title: ValuCheck AI Market Validation & TAM Scraper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since Startup Street explicitly emphasizes business model development and market validation during Day 1, this tool directly helps judges evaluate the viability of other teams' business plans.

ideas.pitch: An automated carbon footprint and sustainability compliance dashboard designed to help early-stage startups audit their operations and generate green-credential pitches for investors.
ideas.title: GreenNovate Business Carbon Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-agent student platform architecture from past winning hacks to automate heavy regulatory paperwork, appealing to the entrepreneurial focus of the event.

ideas.pitch: A platform that ingests unstructured early-stage startup metrics and automatically builds a data-backed Shark Tank-style pitch deck complete with predicted customer acquisition costs.
ideas.title: PitchDeck AI Trust & Traction Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Shark Tank-style final pitch format on Day 2 by turning raw project ideas into polished venture pitches that judges can easily evaluate.

ideas.pitch: A satellite and geospatial data monitoring tool that tracks industrial land and agricultural supply chain compliance to mitigate operational risks for agritech startups.
ideas.title: AgriChain Risk & Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by combining geospatial APIs with compliance algorithms, mimicking successful technical implementations from past hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered risk detection and financial modeling sandbox that lets early-stage fintech startups run stress tests and present bulletproof risk assessments to angel investors.
ideas.title: FinSight AML Risk & Pitch Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes a graph intelligence and risk evaluation stack proven to win 1st place at intense innovation hackathons, providing a robust business-to-business product demo.
